title: Autonomous ORR site/conformer investigation for Ni-substituted MoS2
difficulty_reasons: The endpoint is fixed but the agent must generate and discriminate multiple active-site and adsorption-conformer candidates, justify coverage, and stop with validated evidence.

paper.title: New theoretical insights into doping-induced enhancement of ORR activity in molybdenum disulfide: d–p hybridization or the Jahn–Teller effect?

data.description: Pinned Materials Project host identity and deterministic MoS2(001)/Ni substitution, ORR and measurement boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Candidate search, validated numerical results, coverage, provenance, and conclusion or bounded-failure report.
